THE device access model: this phone's MCP doors and tools, each app's own API routes, each app's IPC routes behind the one mesh gateway, the identities that reach each other without IPC and the app that owns the ADB shell. Read by libs:fleet-data-client DeviceAccess (Cloud Store > Access, Cloud C3 Webserver > API).
